description: This file contains the integration of DataTables library with MDBootstrap for enhancing HTML table functionalities such as pagination, sorting, filtering, and dynamic content management within a web project. It includes module definitions, initialization logic, utility functions, and configurations specific to DataTables.

classes.name: DataTable
classes.description: Main class constructor for initializing and managing DataTables instances, including configuration, event handling, data manipulation, and rendering logic.

classes.name: DataTable.Api
classes.description: The DataTable.Api class provides a chainable API for controlling and accessing DataTables instances. It supports methods for data retrieval, manipulation, and table control, and operates over multiple table contexts with chainable syntax.

methods.name: api
methods.description: Creates a DataTables API instance for chaining and advanced table manipulation.

methods.name: fnAddData
methods.description: Adds new data rows to the table, either singly or multiple, suitable for client-side processing.

methods.name: fnAdjustColumnSizing
methods.description: Recalculates column widths based on data and DOM state, useful after resizing or dynamic content changes.

methods.name: fnClearTable
methods.description: Clears all data from the DataTable, resetting its state.

methods.name: fnClose
methods.description: Closes an open child row if any is open for the given row.

methods.name: fnDeleteRow
methods.description: Removes a specific row from the table based on index or DOM node.

methods.name: fnDestroy
methods.description: Restores the table to its original DOM state and removes DataTable enhancements.

methods.name: fnDraw
methods.description: Redraws the table, optionally re-filtering and re-sorting.

methods.name: fnFilter
methods.description: Filters the table based on a search string, optionally limited to specific columns.

methods.name: fnGetData
methods.description: Retrieves data for the entire table, a specific row, or a specific cell.

methods.name: fnGetNodes
methods.description: Returns DOM nodes of table rows; all or specific by index.

methods.name: fnGetPosition
methods.description: Gets the positional indexes of a table cell or row based on DOM element.

methods.name: fnIsOpen
methods.description: Checks if a child row is currently open for a given row.

methods.name: fnOpen
methods.description: Opens a child row with specified HTML content.

methods.name: fnPageChange
methods.description: Changes the current page programmatically to first, previous, next, last, or specific page number.

methods.name: fnSetColumnVis
methods.description: Shows or hides a specified column.

methods.name: fnSettings
methods.description: Returns the internal settings object for the table.

methods.name: fnSortListener
methods.description: Attaches a click listener to an element to trigger sorting on a column.

methods.name: fnUpdate
methods.description: Updates data in a cell or row, with options for redraw and internal reordering.

methods.name: fnVersionCheck
methods.description: Checks if the current DataTables version meets or exceeds a specified version for compatibility.

methods.name: _fnCallbackReg
methods.description: Registers a callback function with a specific name (label) in the DataTable settings for later execution or event triggering.

methods.name: _fnCallbackFire
methods.description: Executes registered callbacks in reverse order and triggers associated events on the table element, passing provided arguments.

methods.name: _fnLengthOverflow
methods.description: Adjusts the display start index if current settings exceed the end of the dataset, ensuring proper pagination.

methods.name: _fnRenderer
methods.description: Determines the renderer function based on settings and type, choosing specific or default renderers.

methods.name: _fnDataSource
methods.description: Detects whether the table data source is server-side processing ('ssp'), Ajax ('ajax'), or DOM ('dom').

methods.name: DataTable.Api
methods.description: Constructor for API objects that allow chainable operations over multiple tables with context-awareness.

methods.name: fnAddData
methods.description: Adds data rows to the DataTable, supporting various data formats with client-side processing.

methods.name: fnAdjustColumnSizing
methods.description: Recalculates and applies column widths to fit content, useful after resizing or dynamic content changes.

methods.name: fnClearTable
methods.description: Clears all data from the table and resets its state.

methods.name: fnClose
methods.description: Closes an open child row if one exists for the specified row.

methods.name: fnDeleteRow
methods.description: Removes a specific row from the DataTable based on index or DOM node.

methods.name: fnDestroy
methods.description: Resets the table to its original DOM state, removing DataTables enhancements.

methods.name: fnDraw
methods.description: Redraws the DataTable; optionally refiltered and resorted.

methods.name: fnFilter
methods.description: Filters table rows based on a search string, optionally specifying columns.

methods.name: fnGetNodes
methods.description: Returns DOM nodes for table rows, all or selected by index.

methods.name: fnGetPosition
methods.description: Gets the numerical position of a row or cell based on a DOM element.

methods.name: fnIsOpen
methods.description: Checks whether a child row is currently visible for a given row.

methods.name: fnPageChange
methods.description: Changes the current page programmatically to first, previous, next, last, or specific page.

methods.name: fnSettings
methods.description: Returns the internal settings object for the DataTable.

methods.name: fnSort
methods.description: Sorts the table by specified columns and directions.

methods.name: fnSortListener
methods.description: Attaches click listeners to trigger sorting on specified elements.

methods.name: fnUpdate
methods.description: Updates cell or row data and optionally redraws the table.

methods.name: fnVersionCheck
methods.description: Checks compatibility between current DataTables version and a specified version.
